#Reading Barcodes and zUMIs Results
```{r}
# Load barcode metadata
v4_bcs <- fread("/mnt/nvme/home/constantin/resources/barcodes/CD_SS3X_v4_bc_96w_WellID.txt")

# Reading in readspercell txt file (part of zUMIs output)
readsPerCell <- fread(paste0(wd, "zUMIs/zUMIs_output/stats/", yaml_projectName, ".readspercell.txt"))
# Removing all the "bad" quality cells from readsPerCell data table
readsPerCell <- readsPerCell[!readsPerCell$RG == "bad", ]

# Cast to group by barcode
grouped.readsPerCell <- dcast(readsPerCell, RG ~ type, value.var = "N", fill = 0)
colnames(grouped.readsPerCell)[1] <- c("SS3X_Barcode")

# Reading in UMI information
UMIcounts <- fread(paste0(wd, "zUMIs/zUMIs_output/", yaml_projectName, "kept_barcodes_binned.txt.BCUMIstats.txt"))
UMIcounts <- as.data.frame(UMIcounts)

if (seq_type == "PE") {
  UMIcounts <- mutate(UMIcounts, nUMI = nUMItag / 2)
} else {
  UMIcounts <- mutate(UMIcounts, nUMI = nUMItag)
}

colnames(UMIcounts) <- c("SS3X_Barcode", "nUntagged", "nUMItag", "nUMI")
UMIcounts <- UMIcounts[, c(1, 4)]
```

```{r}
table(readsPerCell$type)
```

#Merging and Processing Stats
```{r}
# Combine bcs and grouped.readsPerCell data tables
v4_bcs <- v4_bcs[, c("XC_DNBPE", "vec96_quadrant", "vec_96w", "BCset", "WellID")]
names(v4_bcs)[1] <- "SS3X_Barcode"
combined.stats <- merge(grouped.readsPerCell, v4_bcs, by = "SS3X_Barcode")

# Merge UMIcounts
combined.stats <- inner_join(combined.stats, UMIcounts, by = "SS3X_Barcode")

# Calculate percentage of genes (Exon + Intron) within reads
combined.stats <- as.data.table(combined.stats)
combined.stats <- combined.stats[, nReads := Ambiguity + Exon + Intergenic + Intron + Unmapped][, pct_gene := ((Exon + Intron) / nReads) * 100]
```

#Defining Metadata, Conditions and Wells
```{r}
combined.stats$experiment <- "FC02"

# Assign condition based on BCset
combined.stats <- combined.stats %>%
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
     BCset == "21J"  ~ "unstained",
      BCset == "16P"  ~ "stained",
      BCset == "19N"  ~ "stained",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Assign sample source (cells vs nuclei)
combined.stats <- combined.stats %>%
  mutate(
    sample = case_when(
      BCset == "21J"  ~ "nuclei",
      BCset == "16P"  ~ "nuclei",
      BCset == "19N"  ~ "cells",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

combined.stats$well_info <- paste(combined.stats$sample, combined.stats$condition, sep = "_")

# Add reads division and UMI ratio
combined.stats <- combined.stats %>%
  mutate(
    nUMIBynReads = nUMI / nReads,
    nReads_divBy1000 = round(nReads / 1000)
  )

# Save intermediate processing object
saveRDS(combined.stats, paste0(wd, "analysis/combined.stats.rds"))
```

#QC Plotting Functions and Visualization
```{r}
make_pct_gene_plot_list <- function(data_input, plot_var, color_var, nReads_cutoff, pct_gene_cutoff, filter_data = TRUE, ncol_number, threshold_colors = NULL, custom_colors = NULL, custom_labels = NULL) {
  plot_sym <- sym(plot_var)
  color_sym <- sym(color_var)
  
  color_values <- if (is.factor(data_input[[color_var]])) {
    levels(data_input[[color_var]])
  } else {
    sort(unique(data_input[[color_var]]))
  }
  
  if (is.null(custom_colors)) {
    point_colors <- c("#E64B35FF", "#4DBBD5FF", "#00A087FF")[seq_along(color_values)]
  } else {
    point_colors <- custom_colors
  }
  names(point_colors) <- color_values
  
  make_cutoff_df <- function(cutoff, value_name) {
    if (length(cutoff) == 1) {
      df <- data.frame(group = color_values, value = cutoff)
    } else {
      df <- data.frame(group = names(cutoff), value = unname(cutoff))
    }
    names(df) <- c(color_var, value_name)
    df
  }
  
  nReads_cutoff_df <- make_cutoff_df(nReads_cutoff, "nReads_cutoff")
  pct_gene_cutoff_df <- make_cutoff_df(pct_gene_cutoff, "pct_gene_cutoff")
  
  if (is.null(threshold_colors)) {
    threshold_colors <- setNames(c("firebrick", "darkblue")[seq_along(color_values)], color_values)
  }
  
  plot_values_raw <- if (is.factor(data_input[[plot_var]])) {
    levels(data_input[[plot_var]])
  } else {
    unique(data_input[[plot_var]])
  }
  plot_values <- plot_values_raw[order(readr::parse_number(as.character(plot_values_raw)))]
  
  plot_list <- vector("list", length(plot_values))
  
  for (i in seq_along(plot_values)) {
    plot_chr <- plot_values[i]
    data <- data_input %>% dplyr::filter(!!plot_sym == plot_chr)
    groups_present <- unique(data[[color_var]])
    
    nReads_sub <- nReads_cutoff_df %>% dplyr::filter(!!color_sym %in% groups_present)
    pct_gene_sub <- pct_gene_cutoff_df %>% dplyr::filter(!!color_sym %in% groups_present)
    
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = nReads, y = pct_gene,           group = !!color_sym, color = !!color_sym)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, shape = 20, alpha = 0.45) +
      scale_x_log10() +
      scale_color_manual(values = point_colors, labels =       custom_labels, drop = FALSE) +  
      new_scale_color() +  
      geom_vline(
        data = nReads_sub,
        aes(xintercept = nReads_cutoff, color = !!color_sym),
        linetype = "dashed", size = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_hline(
        data = pct_gene_sub,
        aes(yintercept = pct_gene_cutoff, color = !!color_sym),
        linetype = "dashed", size = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = threshold_colors) +  
      labs(subtitle = plot_chr) +
      xlab("Number of reads (log10 scale)") +  
      ylab("percent gene (exon + intron) [%]") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Times New Roman"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10, family = "Times New Roman"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, family = "Times New Roman"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "Times New Roman"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey96", color = NA),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25))
    
    plot_list[[i]] <- p
  }
  
  combined_plot_pctGene <- Reduce(`+`, plot_list) +
    plot_layout(ncol = ncol_number) &
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  combined_plot_pctGene <- combined_plot_pctGene +
    plot_annotation(
      title = "Number of reads vs % gene",
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Times New Roman"))
    )
  
  if (filter_data) {
    filtered_data <- data_input %>%
      dplyr::left_join(nReads_cutoff_df, by = color_var) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(pct_gene_cutoff_df, by = color_var) %>%
      dplyr::filter(nReads >= nReads_cutoff, pct_gene >= pct_gene_cutoff) %>%
      dplyr::select(-nReads_cutoff, -pct_gene_cutoff)
    return(list(plot_list = combined_plot_pctGene, filtered_data = filtered_data))
  } else {
    return(combined_plot_pctGene)
  }
}
```

#Downsampling Workflows
```{r}
fetch_downsamplings <- function(path_zUMIs, quant = c("exon","inex","intron"), type = c("readcount","umicount")){ 
  path_vector <- list.files(path = paste0(path_zUMIs,"/zUMIs_output/expression/"), pattern = ".rds", full.names = T)
  d <- lapply(path_vector, readRDS)
  lib_names <- gsub(pattern = ".dgecounts.rds", replacement = "", x = as.character(data.frame(strsplit(path_vector, split = "Xpress"), stringsAsFactors = F)[2,]))
  
  for(i in 1:length(d) ){
    rds <- d[[i]]
    depths <- names(rds[[type]][[quant]]$downsampling)
    out <- lapply(depths, function(x){
      dat <- as.matrix(rds[[type]][[quant]]$downsampling[[x]])
      
      out_dt <- data.frame(
        cell = paste0(lib_names[i], "", colnames(dat)),
        nGenes = colSums(dat > 0),
        nUMIs = colSums(dat),
        nReads = as.numeric(gsub(pattern = "downsampled_", replacement = "", x = x)),
        stringsAsFactors = F
      )
      setDT(out_dt)
      return(out_dt)
    })
    out <- rbindlist(out)
    
    if(i == 1){
      downsamp_out <- out
    } else {
      downsamp_out <- rbind(downsamp_out, out)
    }
  }
  
  downsamp_out$type <- type
  downsamp_out$quant <- quant
  return(downsamp_out)
}

make_downsampling <- function(data_input, plot_var, color_var, y_axis_set = T, y_axis_range = c(0,16000), ncol_number, min_cells = 5) {
  data_input$counter <- 1
  
  plot_sym <- sym(plot_var)
  color_sym <- sym(color_var)

  plot_values_raw <- if (is.factor(data_input[[plot_var]])) {
    levels(data_input[[plot_var]])
  } else {
    unique(data_input[[plot_var]])
  }
  plot_values <- plot_values_raw[order(readr::parse_number(as.character(plot_values_raw)))]
  
  plot_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:length(plot_values)) {
    plot_chr <- plot_values[i]
    data_sub <- data_input[data_input[[plot_var]] == plot_chr, ]
    y <- data_sub %>% 
      group_by(!!color_sym, downsample_size) %>%
      summarise(mean_nGenes = mean(nGenes),
                nCells = sum(counter),
                .groups = "drop")
    y <- y[y$nCells >= min_cells, ]
    plot_list[[i]] <- y
    names(plot_list)[[i]] <- plot_chr
  }
  
  base_theme <- theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey96", color = NA),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9), 
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)
    )
  
  plot_list_nGenes <- list()
  plot_list_nCells <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:length(plot_list)) {
    plot_chr <- names(plot_list)[[i]]
    data_plot <- plot_list[[i]]
    
    p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = downsample_size, y = mean_nGenes, group = !!color_sym)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = !!color_sym), size = 0.4) +
      geom_point(aes(color = !!color_sym), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5) + 
      scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
      labs(y = "Mean number of Genes", x = "Number of reads", subtitle = plot_chr) +
      base_theme
    
    if (y_axis_set) {
      p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits = y_axis_range, breaks = seq(y_axis_range[1], y_axis_range[2], by = 2000))
    }
    
    p1 <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = downsample_size, y = nCells, group = !!color_sym)) +
      geom_line(aes(color = !!color_sym), size = 0.4) +
      geom_point(aes(color = !!color_sym), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
      labs(y = "Number of Wells", x = "Number of reads", subtitle = plot_chr) +
      base_theme
    
    plot_list_nGenes[[i]] <- p
    plot_list_nCells[[i]] <- p1
  }
  
  grid_nGenes <- Reduce(`+`, plot_list_nGenes) + plot_layout(ncol = ncol_number)
  grid_nCells <- Reduce(`+`, plot_list_nCells) + plot_layout(ncol = ncol_number)

  return(list(nGenes = grid_nGenes, nCells = grid_nCells))
}

combine_downsampling_plots <- function(grid_nGenes, grid_nCells, min_cells = 5) {
  
  header <- function(label) {
    ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = label, hjust = 0, size = 4.2, fontface = "bold", family = "Times New Roman") +
      xlim(0, 1) + ylim(-1, 1) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 4, b = 2, l = 4, unit = "pt"))
  }
  
  divider <- ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 6, b = 6, unit = "pt"))
  
  combined <- header("Mean number of Genes") / grid_nGenes / divider / header("Number of Wells") / grid_nCells +
    plot_layout(heights = c(0.05, 1, 0.03, 0.05, 1))
  
  combined <- combined +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste0("Downsampling trends, min.cells=", min_cells),
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0, family = "Times New Roman"))
    )
  
  return(combined)
}
```

#Transcriptional Features Distribution (Exon, Intron, Unmapped...)
```{r}
plot_pcts <- combined.stats %>%
  group_by(well_info) %>%
  summarise(
    exon_pct       = (sum(Exon) / sum(nReads)) * 100,
    intron_pct     = (sum(Intron) / sum(nReads)) * 100,
    unmapped_pct   = (sum(Unmapped) / sum(nReads)) * 100,
    intergenic_pct = (sum(Intergenic) / sum(nReads)) * 100,
    ambiguity_pct  = (sum(Ambiguity) / sum(nReads)) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
plot_pcts_long <- plot_pcts %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_pct"),
    names_to = "name",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate( name = factor(name, 
                  levels = c("exon_pct", "intron_pct", "intergenic_pct", "ambiguity_pct", "unmapped_pct"),
                  labels = c("Exon", "Intron", "Intergenic", "Ambiguous", "Unmapped"))
  )

plot_pct <- ggplot(plot_pcts_long, aes(x = well_info, y = value, fill = name)) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(

      "nuclei_stained" = "nuclei (stained)",
```

```{r}
# Function to Load FCS Files
load_fcs_files <- function(file_list, truncate_max = FALSE) {
  facs_list <- lapply(names(file_list), function(sample) {
    fcs <- read.FCS(file_list[[sample]], truncate_max_range = truncate_max, transformation = FALSE)
    df  <- as.data.frame(exprs(fcs))
    
    df$`XINDEX-C` <- as.integer(df$`XINDEX-C`)
    df$`YINDEX-C` <- as.integer(df$`YINDEX-C`)
    
    df <- df[df$`XINDEX-C` > 0 & df$`YINDEX-C` > 0, ]
    
    df$well <- paste0(row_letters[df$`YINDEX-C`], df$`XINDEX-C`)
    df$sample <- sample
    df
  })
  names(facs_list) <- names(file_list)
  facs_list
}
```

# Function for Back-Gating Analysis
```{r}
backgate_analysis <- function(file_list, stats, xlim, ylim, title, y_var = "SSC-A", y_lab = "SSC-A", use_log_y = FALSE) {
  idx_list <- lapply(names(file_list), function(sample_name) {
    fcs <- read.FCS(file_list[[sample_name]], transformation = FALSE)
    df <- as.data.frame(exprs(fcs))
    
    df$`XINDEX-C` <- as.integer(df$`XINDEX-C`)
    df$`YINDEX-C` <- as.integer(df$`YINDEX-C`)
    
    df$sorted <- df$`XINDEX-C` > 0 & df$`YINDEX-C` > 0
    df$well <- ifelse(df$sorted, paste0(row_letters[df$`YINDEX-C`], df$`XINDEX-C`), NA)
    
    df <- left_join(
      df,
      stats %>%
        dplyr::filter(well_info == sample_name) %>%
        dplyr::select(WellID, passed_QC),
      by = c("well" = "WellID")
    )
    
    df$category <- case_when(
      !df$sorted ~ "not sorted",
      df$passed_QC == TRUE ~ "sorted - passed QC",
      TRUE ~ "sorted - failed QC"
    )
    df
  })
  names(idx_list) <- names(file_list)
  
  plot_list <- lapply(names(idx_list), function(sample_name) {
    p <- ggplot(idx_list[[sample_name]], aes_string(x = "`FSC-A`", y = paste0("`", y_var, "`"))) +
      geom_point(
        data = subset(idx_list[[sample_name]], category == "not sorted"),
        color = "grey75", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.3
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = subset(idx_list[[sample_name]], category != "not sorted"),
        aes(color = category), alpha = 0.8, size = 0.5
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "sorted - passed QC" = "blue",
        "sorted - failed QC" = "red"
      )) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
      my_theme +
      labs(title = paste(sample_name), y = y_lab)
    
    if (use_log_y) {
      p <- p + scale_y_log10()
    }
    p
  })
  names(plot_list) <- names(file_list)
  plot_list
}
```

# make some violin plots to define the thresholds for filtering
```{r}
lev <- c("cells_stained", "nuclei_stained", "nuclei_unstained")
seurat_obj$well_info <- factor(seurat_obj$well_info, levels = lev)

grp_cols <- c(cells_stained = "#F8766D", nuclei_stained = "#00BA38", nuclei_unstained = "#619CFF")
grp_labs <- c("Cells", "Nuclei (stained)", "Nuclei (unstained)")

thr <- data.frame(
  x        = 1:3,
  count_lo = c(50000, 10000, 10000),
  feat_lo  = c(7000, 4000, 4000),
  feat_hi  = c(NA, NA, 17000),
  mt_hi    = c(5, 18, 11)
)

qc_vln <- function(feature, ylab, thr_cols, log = FALSE) {
  p <- VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = feature, group.by = "well_info",
               pt.size = 0.3, log = log) +
    labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols, labels = grp_labs) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_family = "Times New Roman", base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
  if (log) p <- p + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma)
  for (cl in thr_cols) {
    d <- thr[!is.na(thr[[cl]]), c("x", cl)]
    names(d) <- c("x", "y")
  
    p <- p + geom_segment(data = d,
                          aes(x = x - 0.4, xend = x + 0.4, y = y, yend =
                                y), 
                          linetype = "22", linewidth = 1.4,
                          color = "firebrick3", inherit.aes = FALSE)
    }
  p
}

p1 <- qc_vln("nCount_RNA",   "Number of reads (log 10 scale)", "count_lo", log = TRUE)
p2 <- qc_vln("nFeature_RNA", "Number of genes detected",              c("feat_lo", "feat_hi"))
p3 <- qc_vln("percent.mt",   "Mitochondrial reads (%)",              "mt_hi")

combined_plot <- (p1 | p2 | p3) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Quality control metrics distribution across samples",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", family = "Times New Roman", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.tag   = element_text (size = 10, family = "Times New Roman")
    )
  ) & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("./QC_combined_metrics.png", combined_plot, width = 26, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 600)
```

#correlation plots between clusters

#subsetting stained and unstained nuclei
```{r}
seu_stained <- subset(seu_nuclei, subset = condition == "stained")
seu_unstained <- subset(seu_nuclei, subset = condition == "unstained")
```

#PCA and UMAP for stained nuclei
```{r}
seu_stained <- SCTransform(
  seu_stained,
  assay = "RNA",
  vst.flavor = "v2",
  vars.to.regress = c("percent.mt", "percent.rb"),
  variable.features.n = 3000,
  verbose = FALSE,
  seed.use = 123
)
seu_stained<- RunPCA(seu_stained, seed.use = 123)
Seurat::ElbowPlot(seu_stained, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
```

```{r}
npcs <- 20
seu_stained <- FindNeighbors(seu_stained, dims = 1:npcs)
seu_stained <- FindClusters(seu_stained, resolution = 0.3)
seu_stained <- RunUMAP(seu_stained, dims = 1:npcs, seed.use = 123)

plot_umap_stained <- DimPlot(seu_stained, reduction = "umap") + labs(title = "Stained nuclei") + my_theme
plot_umap_stained

# Visualize QC metrics as a violin plot
VlnPlot(seu_stained, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), ncol = 2)
plot_stained <- FeatureScatter(seu_stained, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot_stained

ggsave(filename = "./plot_umap_stained.png", plot = plot_umap_stained, width = 20, height = 15, dpi = 150, units = "cm")
```

#combining all UMAPS into a panel
```{r}
plot_list <- list(
  plot_umap_cells, plot_umap_nuclei, 
  umap_condition_nuclei, plot_umap_stained, 
  plot_umap_unstained
)

plot_list <- lapply(plot_list, function(p) {
  p + theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
})

plot_umap_cells       <- plot_list[[1]]
plot_umap_nuclei      <- plot_list[[2]]
umap_condition_nuclei <- plot_list[[3]]
plot_umap_stained     <- plot_list[[4]]
plot_umap_unstained   <- plot_list[[5]]

combined_umap <- (
  (plot_umap_nuclei | umap_condition_nuclei) / (plot_umap_cells | plot_umap_stained |
  plot_umap_unstained)
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "UMAPs for sample type",
    tag_levels = 'A',
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 15, face = "bold", 
        family = "Times New Roman", 
        hjust = 0.45, 
        margin = margin(b = 10)
      ),
      plot.tag = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 13, 
        family = "Times New Roman"
      )
    )
  )

combined_umap

ggsave(
  filename = "combined_umap.png",
  plot = combined_umap,
  width = 12,   
  height = 8,    
  dpi = 600     
)
```

#Gene expression analysis of pluripotency markers
```{r}
divider <- ggplot() + 
  theme_void() + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 1, y = 0.5, yend = 0.5), 
               linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

pluri_markers <- c("NANOG", "POU5F1", "SOX2", "DNMT3B", "GABRB3", "CRIPTO")

get_max_exp <- function(seu, genes) {
  max(apply(FetchData(seu, vars = genes), 2, function(x) quantile(x, 0.98)))
}

max_val_cn <- max(
  get_max_exp(seu_cells, pluri_markers),
  get_max_exp(seu_nuclei, pluri_markers)
)
max_val_su <- max(
  get_max_exp(seu_stained, pluri_markers),
  get_max_exp(seu_unstained, pluri_markers)
)

exp_limits_cn <- c(0, max_val_cn)
exp_limits_su <- c(0, max_val_su)

plot_cells     <- FeaturePlot(seu_cells, features = pluri_markers, reduction = "umap", combine = FALSE)
plot_nuclei    <- FeaturePlot(seu_nuclei, features = pluri_markers, reduction = "umap", combine = FALSE)
plot_stained   <- FeaturePlot(seu_stained, features = pluri_markers, reduction = "umap", combine = FALSE)
plot_unstained <- FeaturePlot(seu_unstained, features = pluri_markers, reduction = "umap", combine = FALSE)

apply_common_scale <- function(plot_list, limit) {
  lapply(plot_list, function(p) {
    p + scale_color_gradient(
      low = "gray85", 
      high = "maroon4", 
      limits = limit,
      oob = scales::squish 
    ) +
      theme(legend.position = "right")
  })
}

title_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(family = "Times"),
  plot.title = element_text(family = "Times", face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.05)
)

plot_cells <- wrap_plots(apply_common_scale(plot_cells, exp_limits_cn), ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Cells", theme = title_theme) & title_theme

plot_nuclei <- wrap_plots(apply_common_scale(plot_nuclei, exp_limits_cn), ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Nuclei", theme = title_theme) & title_theme

plot_stained <- wrap_plots(apply_common_scale(plot_stained, exp_limits_su), ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Stained nuclei", theme = title_theme) & title_theme

plot_unstained <- wrap_plots(apply_common_scale(plot_unstained, exp_limits_su), ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Unstained nuclei", theme = title_theme) & title_theme


grid_cells_vs_nuclei <- wrap_elements(full = plot_cells) / 
                         divider / 
                         wrap_elements(full = plot_nuclei)
grid_cells_vs_nuclei <- grid_cells_vs_nuclei + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.05, 1))

ggsave("./geneExpression_Cells_vs_Nuclei_grid.png", plot = grid_cells_vs_nuclei, 
       width = 30, height = 40, dpi = 300, units = "cm")

grid_stained_vs_unstained <- wrap_elements(full = plot_stained) / divider / wrap_elements(full = plot_unstained)
grid_stained_vs_unstained <- grid_stained_vs_unstained + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.05, 1))

ggsave("./geneExpression_stained_vs_unstained.png", plot = grid_stained_vs_unstained, 
       width = 30, height = 40, dpi = 300, units = "cm")

grid_cells_vs_stained_vs_unstained <- wrap_elements(full = plot_cells) / divider / wrap_elements(full = plot_stained) / divider / wrap_elements(full = plot_unstained)
grid_cells_vs_stained_vs_unstained <- grid_cells_vs_stained_vs_unstained + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.05, 1, 0.05, 1)) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Gene expression analysis of pluripotency markers",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        family = "Times", 
        size = 20,        
        face = "bold",      
        hjust = 0.5 
      )
    )
  )

ggsave("./geneExpression_cells_vs_stained_vs_unstained.png", plot = grid_cells_vs_stained_vs_unstained, 
       width = 30, height = 40, dpi = 600, units = "cm")
```

#Boxplots for expression of marker genes
```{r}
pluri_markers <- c("NANOG", "POU5F1", "SOX2", "DNMT3B", "GABRB3", "CRIPTO")

df_cells <- FetchData(seu_cells, vars = pluri_markers)
df_cells$condition <- "Cells"

df_stained <- FetchData(seu_stained, vars = pluri_markers)
df_stained$condition <- "Nuclei (stained)"

df_unstained <- FetchData(seu_unstained, vars = pluri_markers)
df_unstained$condition <- "Nuclei (unstained)"

df_all <- bind_rows(df_cells, df_stained, df_unstained) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Cells", "Nuclei (stained)", "Nuclei (unstained)"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(pluri_markers), names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = pluri_markers))

boxplot_pluri <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = condition, y = Expression, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.6, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, ncol = 3) 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Cells" = "#F8766D", "Nuclei (stained)" = "#00BA38", "Nuclei (unstained)" = "#619CFF")
  ) +
  labs(y = "Normalized Expression", x = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_family = "Times New Roman", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 13), 
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),                         
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

boxplot_pluri
```

#Panel of UMAP with gene expression and boxplot
```{r}
max_exp <- max(
  FetchData(seu_cells, vars = "POU5F1"),
  FetchData(seu_stained, vars = "POU5F1"),
  FetchData(seu_unstained, vars = "POU5F1")
)

shared_scale <- scale_color_gradient(
  low = "lightgrey", 
  high = "blue", 
  limits = c(0, max_exp), 
  oob = scales::squish
)

p_cells_umap <- FeaturePlot(seu_cells, features = "POU5F1") + 
  theme_void(base_family = "Times New Roman") + 
  ggtitle("Cells") + shared_scale + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_stained_umap <- FeaturePlot(seu_stained, features = "POU5F1") + 
  theme_void(base_family = "Times New Roman") + 
  ggtitle("Nuclei (stained)") + shared_scale + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_unstained_umap <- FeaturePlot(seu_unstained, features = "POU5F1") + 
  theme_void(base_family = "Times New Roman") + 
  ggtitle("Nuclei (unstained)") + shared_scale +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "italic", size = 13, vjust = 1)
  )

final_pluri_fig <- (p_cells_umap | p_stained_umap | p_unstained_umap) / boxplot_pluri + 
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.8)) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    title = "Expression of pluripotency markers across conditions",
    subtitle = "A-C: POU5F1 expression projected onto UMAP embedding", 
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "italic", size = 13, hjust = 0.5), 
      plot.tag = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "bold", size = 15)
    )
  )

ggsave("./geneExpression_Pluripotency_Combined.png", plot = final_pluri_fig, width = 20, height = 22, dpi = 600, units = "cm", bg = "white")
```

#comparison of gene expression between clusters
```{r}
pct_expressed <- function(seu, cluster_col = "seurat_clusters", assay = "SCT", layer = "data") {
  cnt_mat <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, layer = layer)
  clusters <- as.character(seu@meta.data[[cluster_col]])
  levs <- sort(unique(na.omit(clusters)))
  out <- sapply(levs, function(cl) {
    cells <- which(clusters == cl)
    Matrix::rowSums(cnt_mat[, cells, drop = FALSE] > 0) / length(cells)
  })
  colnames(out) <- levs
  as.data.frame(out)
}
```

```{r}
pct_df_us <- pct_expressed(seu_unstained)

PCT_threshold <- 0.1 

genes_expressed_c0_us <- rownames(pct_df_us)[pct_df_us$"0" > PCT_threshold]
genes_expressed_c1_us <- rownames(pct_df_us)[pct_df_us$"1" > PCT_threshold]
genes_expressed_c2_us <- rownames(pct_df_us)[pct_df_us$"2" > PCT_threshold]

expressed_common_list_us <- list(
  "Cluster_0" = genes_expressed_c0_us,
  "Cluster_1" = genes_expressed_c1_us,
  "Cluster_2" = genes_expressed_c2_us
)

jpeg(
  "upset_us.jpeg",
  width = 25,
  height = 18,
  units = "cm",
  res = 1000,
  quality = 75
)

UpSetR::upset(
  fromList(expressed_common_list_us),
  order.by = "freq",
  main.bar.color = "#2c3e50",
  sets.bar.color = "#1abc9c",
  mainbar.y.label = "Number of genes",
  sets.x.label = "Genes per cluster",
  set_size.scale_max = 22000,
  text.scale = c(
    1.8, 
    1.5,
    1.8, 
    1.5, 
    1.8, 
    2.0  
  )
)

dev.off()
```
